1: # Changelog
2: 
3: All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.
4: 
5: The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/),
6: and this project adheres to [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).
7: 
8: Given a version number MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, increment the:
9: 
10:     MAJOR version when you make incompatible API changes.
11:     MINOR version when you add functionality in a backward compatible manner.
12:     PATCH version when you make backward compatible bug fixes.
13: 
14: ## [0.2.0-Unreleased]
15: 
16: ### Added
17: 
18: - Code examples
19: - README now documents which headers are needed and the copy-only
20:   consumption path (header-only; copy the headers into the project, no build
21:   step required).
22: - CMake consumption improvements: added the `TiffCraft::TiffCraft` namespaced
23:   alias, an installable/exportable target with generated
24:   `TiffCraftConfig.cmake`/`TiffCraftConfigVersion.cmake` (for `find_package`),
25:   and a `TIFFCRAFT_BUILD_ALL` option that defaults to `ON` when building
26:   TiffCraft standalone and to `OFF` when consumed via `FetchContent` or
27:   `add_subdirectory`.
28: - Version-consistency test between the CMake `PROJECT_VERSION` and the header
29:   version constants (`TiffCraft::version()`), failing with both values named on
30:   mismatch.
31: 
32: ### Changed
33: 
34: - CMake project version bumped to `0.2.0` to match the header version
35:   constants and the `[0.2.0-Unreleased]` changelog section.
36: 
37: ### Fixed
38: 
39: - `TiffExporter.hpp` no longer includes the umbrella header `TiffCraft.hpp`;
40:   it now includes `TiffImage.hpp` directly, resolving the include cycle and
41:   making the exporter header standalone.
42: - ODR violations in headers: `inline` on `version()`, `readAt()`, `writeAt()`,
43:   and both `load()` overloads (`TiffImage.hpp`); the six `operator<<` overloads
44:   moved into `namespace TiffCraft` and marked `inline` (`TiffStdOut.hpp`).
45:   Note: the stream operators are no longer visible in the global namespace;
46:   they are found via ADL, which applies to all TiffCraft types.
47: - Crash/hang fixes for malformed TIFF input: ASCII entry with count 0 no
48:   longer reads out of bounds (throws `std::runtime_error`); RATIONAL/SRATIONAL
49:   entries with a zero denominator no longer divide by zero (throws
50:   `std::runtime_error`); cyclic IFD offsets are detected and rejected (throws
51:   `std::runtime_error`).
52: - `readAt()` now detects short reads and throws `std::runtime_error`, so
53:   truncated strips/tiles no longer silently yield zero-filled buffers.
54: - `takeImage()` no longer copies instead of moving; it moves the image buffer
55:   out of the exporter, leaving it empty.
56: - `TiffExporterAny` now resets its multi-IFD state per IFD; each IFD is
57:   exported and the last successfully exported image wins (previously later
58:   IFDs were silently skipped).
59: - Example `tiff_image` reads `ImageWidth`/`ImageLength` type-agnostically, so

1: # Changelog
2: 
3: All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.
4: 
5: The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/),
6: and this project adheres to [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).
7: 
8: Given a version number MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, increment the:
9: 
10:     MAJOR version when you make incompatible API changes.
11:     MINOR version when you add functionality in a backward compatible manner.
12:     PATCH version when you make backward compatible bug fixes.
13: 
14: ## [0.2.0-Unreleased]
15: 
16: ### Added
17: 
18: - Code examples
19: - README now documents which headers are needed and the copy-only
20:   consumption path (header-only; copy the headers into the project, no build
21:   step required).
22: - CMake consumption improvements: added the `TiffCraft::TiffCraft` namespaced
23:   alias, an installable/exportable target with generated
24:   `TiffCraftConfig.cmake`/`TiffCraftConfigVersion.cmake` (for `find_package`),
25:   and a `TIFFCRAFT_BUILD_ALL` option that defaults to `ON` when building
26:   TiffCraft standalone and to `OFF` when consumed via `FetchContent` or
27:   `add_subdirectory`.
28: - Version-consistency test between the CMake `PROJECT_VERSION` and the header
29:   version constants (`TiffCraft::version()`), failing with both values named on
30:   mismatch.
31: 
32: ### Changed
33: 
34: - CMake project version bumped to `0.2.0` to match the header version
35:   constants and the `[0.2.0-Unreleased]` changelog section.
36: 
37: ### Fixed
38: 
39: - `TiffExporter.hpp` no longer includes the umbrella header `TiffCraft.hpp`;
40:   it now includes `TiffImage.hpp` directly, resolving the include cycle and
41:   making the exporter header standalone.
42: - ODR violations in headers: `inline` on `version()`, `readAt()`, `writeAt()`,
43:   and both `load()` overloads (`TiffImage.hpp`); the six `operator<<` overloads
44:   moved into `namespace TiffCraft` and marked `inline` (`TiffStdOut.hpp`).
45:   Note: the stream operators are no longer visible in the global namespace;
46:   they are found via ADL, which applies to all TiffCraft types.
47: - Crash/hang fixes for malformed TIFF input: ASCII entry with count 0 no
48:   longer reads out of bounds (throws `std::runtime_error`); RATIONAL/SRATIONAL
49:   entries with a zero denominator no longer divide by zero (throws
50:   `std::runtime_error`); cyclic IFD offsets are detected and rejected (throws
51:   `std::runtime_error`).
52: - `readAt()` now detects short reads and throws `std::runtime_error`, so
53:   truncated strips/tiles no longer silently yield zero-filled buffers.
54: - `takeImage()` no longer copies instead of moving; it moves the image buffer
55:   out of the exporter, leaving it empty.
56: - `TiffExporterAny` now resets its multi-IFD state per IFD; each IFD is
57:   exported and the last successfully exported image wins (previously later
58:   IFDs were silently skipped).
59: - Example `tiff_image` reads `ImageWidth`/`ImageLength` type-agnostically, so
60:   LONG-typed entries no longer throw.
61: - README quick-start snippet fixed (removed undeclared `loadParams` argument;
62:   fixed `iffExporter` typo).
63: - `Type::BYTE` entries print as integers instead of raw characters.
64: 
65: ## [0.1.0]
66: 
67: ### Added
68: 
69: - Initial TiffCraft code for loading TIFF images and exporter for bilevel,
70:   grayscale, palette-color, and RGB images. Compression is not supported.
71: - Example `tiff_exporter` program to convert TIFF images to PNG 8-bit format.
72: 
73: ### Changed
74: 
75: - Moved all headers to `include/tiffcraft`.

```python
def assemble(path, entries, arrays_data, strip_data, next_ifd=0):
    # entries: list of (tag, type, count, raw) sorted by tag
    n = len(entries)
    ifd_size = 2 + 12*n + 4
    cur = 8 + ifd_size
    arr_pos = {}
    for e in entries:
        size = TYPE_SIZE[e[1]] * e[2]
        if size > 4:
            if cur % 2 != 0: cur += 1
            arr_pos[id(e)] = cur
            cur += size
    strip_off = cur
    buf = bytearray()
    buf += b'II' + struct.pack('<HI', 42, 8)
    # IFD
    buf += struct.pack('<H', n)
    for e in entries:
        tag, typ, count, raw = e
        size = TYPE_SIZE[typ]*count
        if size <= 4:
            field = int.from_bytes(raw.ljust(4, b'\x00'), 'little')
        else:
            field = arr_pos[id(e)]
        buf += struct.pack('<HHI', tag, typ, count) + struct.pack('<I', field)
    buf += struct.pack('<I', next_ifd)
    assert len(buf) == 8 + ifd_size, (len(buf), 8+ifd_size)
    for e in entries:
        size = TYPE_SIZE[e[1]]*e[2]
        if size > 4:
            if len(buf) % 2 != 0: buf += b'\x00'
            buf += e[3]
    buf += strip_data
    open(path, 'wb').write(bytes(buf))
```

    n = len(entries)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate YCbCr test TIFFs (tests/ycbcr_images) and RGB ground-truth PPMs
(tests/reference_images) for issue #38. Deterministic; writes classic TIFF
(Compression=1, little-endian) and Netpbm ASCII PPM (P3) files."""

import os
import struct

TIF_DIR = "/home/daniel/tiffcraft/tests/ycbcr_images"
PPM_DIR = "/home/daniel/tiffcraft/tests/reference_images"
os.makedirs(TIF_DIR, exist_ok=True)
os.makedirs(PPM_DIR, exist_ok=True)

TYPE_SIZE = {1: 1, 2: 1, 3: 2, 4: 4, 5: 8, 6: 1, 7: 1, 8: 2, 9: 4, 10: 8, 11: 4, 12: 8}

Y601 = (0.299, 0.587, 0.114)
CB601 = (-0.168736, -0.331264, 0.5)
CR601 = (0.5, -0.418688, -0.081312)
Y709 = (0.2126, 0.7152, 0.0722)
CB709 = (-0.1146, -0.3854, 0.5)
CR709 = (0.5, -0.4187, -0.0812)


def clamp8(v):
    return 0 if v < 0 else (255 if v > 255 else int(v))


def forward(R, G, B, ycoef, ccoef, rcoef):
    Y = ycoef[0] * R + ycoef[1] * G + ycoef[2] * B
    Cb = ccoef[0] * R + ccoef[1] * G + ccoef[2] * B + 128
    Cr = rcoef[0] * R + rcoef[1] * G + rcoef[2] * B + 128
    return (clamp8(round(Y)), clamp8(round(Cb)), clamp8(round(Cr)))


def inverse(Y, Cb, Cr, y709, refbw):
    bY, wY, bCb, wCb, bCr, wCr = refbw
    nY = (Y - bY) / float(wY - bY)
    nCb = (Cb - bCb) / float(wCb - bCb)
    nCr = (Cr - bCr) / float(wCr - bCr)
    Ys = bY + nY * (wY - bY)
    Cbs = bCb + nCb * (wCb - bCb)
    Crs = bCr + nCr * (wCr - bCr)
    if y709:
        R = Ys + 1.574 * (Crs - 128)
        G = Ys - 0.328 * (Cbs - 128) - 0.672 * (Crs - 128)
        B = Ys + 1.84 * (Cbs - 128) - 0.084 * (Crs - 128)
    else:
        R = Ys + 1.402 * (Crs - 128)
        G = Ys - 0.344136 * (Cbs - 128) - 0.714136 * (Crs - 128)
        B = Ys + 1.772 * (Cbs - 128) - 0.081312 * (Crs - 128)
    return (clamp8(round(R)), clamp8(round(G)), clamp8(round(B)))


REF_DEFAULT = (0, 255, 0, 128, 0, 128)
REF_CUSTOM = (16, 239, 16, 112, 16, 112)


def source_pixels(case_idx, W, H):
    px = []
    for y in range(H):
        row = []
        for x in range(W):
            r = int((x * 37 + y * 91 + case_idx * 53) % 256)
            g = int((x * 17 + y * 29 + case_idx * 97) % 256)
            b = int((x * 7 + y * 13 + case_idx * 31) % 256)
            row.append((r, g, b))
        px.append(row)
    return px


def ycbcr_planes(src, W, H, h, v, ycoef, ccoef, rcoef, bits):
    ch = -(-H // v)
    cw = -(-W // h)
    Yp = [[0] * W for _ in range(H)]
    Cbp = [[0] * cw for _ in range(ch)]
    Crp = [[0] * cw for _ in range(ch)]
    for y in range(H):
        for x in range(W):
            r, g, b = src[y][x]
            Y, Cb, Cr = forward(r, g, b, ycoef, ccoef, rcoef)
            Yp[y][x] = Y
            if bits == 16:
                Y, Cb, Cr = Y * 257, Cb * 257, Cr * 257
            j = y // v
            i = x // h
            Cbp[j][i] = Cb
            Crp[j][i] = Cr
    return Yp, Cbp, Crp, cw, ch


def rationals(refbw):
    bY, wY, bCb, wCb, bCr, wCr = refbw
    vals = [(bY, 1), (wY, 1), (bCb, 1), (wCb, 1), (bCr, 1), (wCr, 1)]
    return b''.join(struct.pack('<II', n, d) for (n, d) in vals)

    y = Y709 if y709 else Y601
    return b''.join(struct.pack('<II', int(round(v * 10000)), 10000) for v in (y[0], y[1], y[2]))

    Yp: H x W Y samples; Cbp/Crp: ch x (ceil(W/h)) chroma samples.
    planar=1 -> chunky (SamplesPerPixel=3, pixel-interleaved Y/Cb/Cr).
    planar=2 -> separate (3 strips: Y, Cb, Cr).
    tiled -> tile-based layout (TileWidth/TileLength).
    """
    entries = []

    def add(tag, typ, count, raw):
        entries.append((tag, typ, count, raw))

    strip_data = b''
    strip_sizes = []
    nstrips = 0
    tiled_offsets = []
    tiled_counts = []

        ts = tile_size

            tx = 0
            while tx < W:
                y0, y1 = ty, min(ty + ts, H)
                x0, x1 = tx, min(tx + ts, W)
                buf = bytearray()
                for y in range(y0, y1):
                    for x in range(x0, x1):
                        if bits == 8:
                            buf += bytes([Yp[y][x], Cbp[y // v][x // h], Crp[y // v][x // h]])
                        else:
                            buf += struct.pack('<HHH', Yp[y][x], Cbp[y // v][x // h], Crp[y // v][x / 1 * 0 + x // h])
                tiles.append(bytes(buf))
                tx += ts
            ty += ts
        nt = len(tiles)
        tiled_counts = [len(t) for t in tiles]
        tile_data = b''.join(tiles)
        strip_data = tile_data
        nstrips = nt
        n_entries = 16
        add(256, 4, 1, struct.pack('<I', W))
        add(257, 4, 1, struct.pack('<I', H))
        add(258, 3, 3, struct.pack('<HHH', bits, bits, bits))
        add(259, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', 1))
        add(262, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', 6))
        add(277, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', 3))
        add(284, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', planar))
        add(317, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', 1))
        add(322, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', tile_size))
        add(323, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', tile_size))
        add(324, 4, nt, struct.pack('<' + 'I' * nt, *([0] * nt)))
        add(325, 4, nt, struct.pack('<' + 'I' * nt, *tiled_counts))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate YCbCr test TIFFs (tests/ycbcr_images) and RGB ground-truth PPMs
(tests/reference_images) for issue #38. Deterministic; writes classic TIFF
(Compression=1, little-endian) and Netpbm ASCII PPM (P3) files."""

import os
import struct

TIF_DIR = "/home/daniel/tiffcraft/tests/ycbcr_images"
PPM_DIR = "/home/daniel/tiffcraft/tests/reference_images"
os.makedirs(TIF_DIR, exist_ok=True)
os.makedirs(PPM_DIR, exist_ok=True)

TYPE_SIZE = {1: 1, 2: 1, 3: 2, 4: 4, 5: 8, 6: 1, 7: 1, 8: 2, 9: 4, 10: 8, 11: 4, 12: 8}

Y601 = (0.299, 0.587, 0.114)
CB601 = (-0.168736, -0.331264, 0.5)
CR601 = (0.5, -0.418688, -0.081312)
Y709 = (0.2126, 0.7152, 0.0722)
CB709 = (-0.1146, -0.3854, 0.5)
CR709 = (0.5, -0.4187, -0.0812)


def clamp8(v):
    return 0 if v < 0 else (255 if v > 255 else int(v))


def forward(R, G, B, ycoef, ccoef, rcoef):
    Y = ycoef[0] * R + ycoef[1] * G + ycoef[2] * B
    Cb = ccoef[0] * R + ccoef[1] * G + ccoef[2] * B + 128
    Cr = rcoef[0] * R + rcoef[1] * G + rcoef[2] * B + 128
    return (clamp8(round(Y)), clamp8(round(Cb)), clamp8(round(Cr)))


def inverse(Y, Cb, Cr, y709, refbw):
    bY, wY, bCb, wCb, bCr, wCr = refbw
    nY = (Y - bY) / float(wY - bY)
    nCb = (Cb - bCb) / float(wCb - bCb)
    nCr = (Cr - bCr) / float(wCr - bCr)
    Ys = bY + nY * (wY - bY)
    Cbs = bCb + nCb * (wCb - bCb)
    Crs = bCr + nCr * (wCr - bCr)
    if y709:
        R = Ys + 1.574 * (Crs - 128)
        G = Ys - 0.328 * (Cbs - 128) - 0.672 * (Crs - 128)
        B = Ys + 1.84 * (Cbs - 128) - 0.084 * (Crs - 128)
    else:
        R = Ys + 1.402 * (Crs - 128)
        G = Ys - 0.344136 * (Cbs - 128) - 0.714136 * (Crs - 128)
        B = Ys + 1.772 * (Cbs - 128) - 0.081312 * (Crs - 128)
    return (clamp8(round(R)), clamp8(round(G)), clamp8(round(B)))


REF_DEFAULT = (0, 255, 0, 128, 0, 128)
REF_CUSTOM = (16, 239, 16, 112, 16, 112)


def source_pixels(case_idx, W, H):
    px = []
    for y in range(H):
        row = []
        for x in range(W):
            r = int((x * 37 + y * 91 + case_idx * 53) % 256)
            g = int((x * 17 + y * 29 + case_idx * 97) % 256)
            b = int((x * 7 + y * 13 + case_idx * 31) % 256)
            row.append((r, g, b))
        px.append(row)
    return px


def ycbcr_planes(src, W, H, h, v, ycoef, ccoef, rcoef, bits):
    ch = -(-H // v)
    cw = -(-W // h)
    Yp = [[0] * W for _ in range(H)]
    Cbp = [[0] * cw for _ in range(ch)]
    Crp = [[0] * cw for _ in range(ch)]
    for y in range(H):
        for x in range(W):
            r, g, b = src[y][x]
            Y, Cb, Cr = forward(r, g, b, ycoef, ccoef, rcoef)
            Yp[y][x] = Y
            if bits == 16:
                Y, Cb, Cr = Y * 257, Cb * 257, Cr * 257
            j = y // v
            i = x // h
            Cbp[j][i] = Cb
            Crp[j][i] = Cr
    return Yp, Cbp, Crp, cw, ch


def rationals(refbw):
    bY, wY, bCb, wCb, bCr, wCr = refbw
    vals = [(bY, 1), (wY, 1), (bCb, 1), (wCb, 1), (bCr, 1), (wCr, 1)]
    return b''.join(struct.pack('<II', n, d) for (n, d) in vals)


def coeffs_bytes(y709):
    y = Y709 if y709 else Y601
    return b''.join(struct.pack('<II', int(round(v * 10000)), 10000) for v in (y[0], y[1], y[2]))


def write_tiff(path, W, H, bits, h, v, positioning, planar, tiled, tile_size, Yp, Cbp, Crp, ch, refbw, y709):
    entries = []

    def add(tag, typ, count, raw):
        entries.append((tag, typ, count, raw))

    strip_data = b''
    strip_sizes = []
    strip_offsets = []
    tiled_offsets = []
    tiled_counts = []

    if tiled:
        ts = tile_size
        tiles = []
        ty = 0
        while ty < H:
            tx = 0
            while tx < W:
                y0, y1 = ty, min(ty + ts, H)
                x0, x1 = tx, min(tx + ts, W)
                buf = bytearray()
                for y in range(y0, y1):
                    for x in range(x0, x1):
                        if bits == 8:
                            buf += bytes([Yp[y][x], Cbp[y // v][x // h], Crp[y // v][x // h]])
                        else:
                            buf += struct.pack('<HHH', Yp[y][x], Cbp[y // v][x // h], Crp[y // v][x // h])
                tiles.append(bytes(buf))
                tx += ts
            ty += ts
        nt = len(tiles)
        tiled_counts = [len(t) for t in tiles]
        strip_data = b''.join(tiles)
        nstrips = nt
        add(256, 4, 1, struct.pack('<I', W))
        add(257, 4, 1, struct.pack('<I', H))
        add(258, 3, 3, struct.pack('<HHH', bits, bits, bits))
        add(259, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', 1))
        add(262, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', 6))
        add(277, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', 3))
        add(284, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', planar))
        add(317, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', 1))
        add(322, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', tile_size))
        add(323, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', tile_size))
        add(324, 4, nt, struct.pack('<' + 'I' * nt, *([0] * nt)))
        add(325, 4, nt, struct.pack('<' + 'I' * nt, *tiled_counts))
        add(339, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', 1))
        add(529, 5, 3, coeffs_bytes(y709))
        add(530, 3, 2, struct.pack('<HH', h, v))
        add(531, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', positioning))
        add(532, 5, 6, rationals(refbw))

    elif planar == 2:
        if bits == 8:
            s0 = bytes(bytearray([Yp[y][x] for y in range(H) for x in range(W)]))
            s1 = bytes(bytearray([Cbp[j][i] for j in range(ch) for i in range(len(Cbp[0]))]))
            s2 = bytes(bytearray([Crp[j][i] for j in range(ch) for i in range(len(Crp[0]))]))
        else:
            def pack_plane16(plane, rows, cols):
                out = bytearray()
                for j in range(rows):
                    for i in range(cols):
                        out += struct.pack('<HH', plane[j][i], plane[j][i])
                return bytes(out)
            s0 = pack_plane16(Yp, H, W)
            s1 = pack_plane16(Cbp, ch, len(Cbp[0]))
            s2 = pack_plane16(Crp, ch, len(Crp[0]))
        strip_data = s0 + s1 + s2
        strip_sizes = [len(s0), len(s1), len(s2)]
        nstrips = 3
        add(256, 4, 1, struct.pack('<I', W))
        add(257, 4, 1, struct.pack('<I', H))
        add(258, 3, 3, struct.pack('<HHH', bits, bits, bits))
        add(259, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', 1))
        add(262, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', 6))
        add(273, 4, 3, struct.pack('<' + 'I' * 3, *([0] * 3)))
        add(277, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', 3))
        add(278, 4, 1, struct.pack('<I', H))
        add(279, 4, 3, struct.pack('<' + 'I' * 3, *([0] * 3)))
        add(284, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', planar))
        add(317, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', 1))
        add(339, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', 1))
        add(529, 5, 3, coeffs_bytes(y709))
        add(530, 3, 2, struct.pack('<HH', h, v))
        add(531, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', positioning))
        add(532, 5, 6, rationals(refbw))

    if planar == 1:
        if bits == 8:
            sd = bytearray()
            for y in range(H):
                for x in range(W):
                    sd += bytes([Yp[y][x], Cbp[y // v][x // h], Crp[y // v][x // h]])
            strip_data = bytes(sd)
        else:
            sd = bytearray()
            for y in range(H):
                for x in range(W):
                    sd += struct.pack('<HHH', Yp[y][x], Cbp[y // v][x // h], Crp[y // v][x // h])
            strip_data = bytes(sd)
        strip_sizes = [len(strip_data)]
        nstrips = 1
        add(273, 4, 1, struct.pack('<I', 0))
        add(277, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', 3))
        add(278, 4, 1, struct.pack('<I', H))
        add(279, 4, 1, struct.pack('<I', len(strip_data)))
        add(284, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', planar))
        add(317, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', 1))
        add(339, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', 1))
        add(529, 5, 3, coeffs_bytes(y709))
        add(530, 3, 2, struct.pack('<HH', h, v))
        add(531, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', positioning))
        add(532, 5, 6, rationals(refbw))

    entries = sorted(entries, key=lambda e: e[0])
    n_entries = len(entries)

    ifd_size = 2 + 12 * n_entries + 4
    cur = 8 + ifd_size
    pos_map = {}
    for e in entries:
        size = TYPE_SIZE[e[1]] * e[2]
        if size > 4:
            if cur % 2 != 0:
                cur += 1
            pos_map[id(e)] = cur
            cur += size
    strip_off = cur
    strip_offsets = []
    off = strip_off
    for s in strip_sizes:
        strip_offsets.append(off)
        off += s

    entries2 = []
    for e in entries:
        tag, typ, count, raw = e
        if tag == 273:
            raw = struct.pack('<' + 'I' * count, *strip_offsets)
        if tag == 279:
            raw = struct.pack('<' + 'I' * count, *[strip_sizes[i] for i in range(count)])
        entries2.append((tag, typ, count, raw))
    entries = sorted(entries2, key=lambda e: e[0])
    n_entries = len(entries)

    ifd_size = 2 + 12 * n_entries + 4
    cur = 8 + ifd_size
    pos_map = {}
    for e in entries:
        size = TYPE_SIZE[e[1]] * e[2]
        if size > 4:
            if cur % 2 != 0:
                cur += 1
            pos_map[id(e)] = cur
            cur += size
    strip_off = cur

    buf = bytearray()
    buf += b'II' + struct.pack('<HI', 42, 8)
    buf += struct.pack('<H', n_entries)
    for e in entries:
        tag, typ, count, raw = e
        size = TYPE_SIZE[typ] * count

        else:

        buf += struct.pack('<HHI', tag, typ, count) + struct.pack('<I', field)
    buf += struct.pack('<I', 0)
    for e in entries:
        tag, typ, count, raw = e
        size = TYPE_SIZE[typ] * count
        if size > 4:
            if len(buf) % 2 != 0:
                buf += b'\x00'
            buf += raw

    with open(path, 'wb') as f:
        f.write(bytes(buf))

    with open(path, 'w') as f:
        f.write("P3\n")
        f.write("%d %d\n" % (W, H))
        f.write("%d\n" % maxval)
        for row in rgb_rows:
            for (r, g, b) in row:
                f.write("%d %d %d\n" % (int(r), int(g), int(b)))


def main():
    specs = [
        # Subsampling coverage (all centered, default coeffs, default RefBW, chunky, Bits 8, 64x48)
        ("ycbcr-1x1",      64,  48, 1, 1, 1, 1, False, 16, 8, False, REF_DEFAULT),
        ("ycbcr-2x1",      64,  48, 2, 1, 1, 1, False, 16, 8, False, REF_DEFAULT),
        ("ycbcr-1x2",      64,  48, 1, 2, 1, 1, False, 16, 8, False, REF_DEFAULT),
        ("ycbcr-2x2",      64,  48, 2, 2, 1, 1, False, 16, 8, False, REF_DEFAULT),
        ("ycbcr-4x1",      64,  48, 4, 1, 1, 1, False, 16, 8, False, REF_DEFAULT),
        ("ycbcr-1x4",      64,  48, 1, 4, 1, 1, False, 16, 8, False, REF_DEFAULT),
        ("ycbcr-4x2",      64,  48, 4, 2, 1, 1, False, 16, 8, False, REF_DEFAULT),
        ("ycbcr-2x4",      64,  48, 2, 4, 1, 1, False, 16, 8, False, REF_DEFAULT),
        ("ycbcr-4x4",      64,  48, 4, 4, 1, 1, False, 16, 8, False, REF_DEFAULT),
        # Variants
        ("ycbcr-cosited",  64,  48, 2, 2, 2, 1, False, 16, 8, False, REF_DEFAULT),
        ("ycbcr-custom-coeffs", 64, 48, 1, 1, 1, 1, False, 16, 8, True, REF_DEFAULT),
        ("ycbcr-custom-refbw", 64, 48, 1, 1, 1, 1, False, 16, 8, False, REF_CUSTOM),
        ("ycbcr-planar-2x2", 64, 48, 2, 2, 1, 2, False, 16, 8, False, REF_DEFAULT),
        ("ycbcr-tiled-2x2", 64, 48, 2, 2, 1, 1, True, 16, 8, False, REF_DEFAULT),
        ("ycbcr-16bit-1x1", 64,  48, 1, 1, 1, 1, False, 16, 16, False, REF_DEFAULT),
        # Odd sizes
        ("ycbcr-odd-2x2",  61,  47, 2, 2, 1, 1, False, 16, 8, False, REF_DEFAULT),
        ("ycbcr-odd-4x4",  63,  61, 4, 4, 1, 1, False, 16, 8, False, REF_DEFAULT),
        ("ycbcr-odd-mixed", 62,  47, 2, 1, 1, 1, False, 16, 8, False, REF_DEFAULT),
    ]

    for idx, (name, W, H, h, v, positioning, planar, tiled, tile_size, bits, y709, refbw) in enumerate(specs):
        src = source_pixels(idx * 7 + 3, W, H)
        ycoef, ccoef, rcoef = (Y709, CB709, CR709) if y709 else (Y601, CB601, CR601)
        Yp, Cbp, Crp, cw, ch = ycbcr_planes(src, W, H, h, v, ycoef, ccoef, rcoef, bits)
        tif_path = os.path.join(TIF_DIR, name + '.tif')
        write_tiff(tif_path, W, H, bits, h, v, positioning, planar, tiled, tile_size, Yp, Cbp, Crp, ch, refbw, y709)

        rgb_rows = []
        for y in range(H):
            row = []
            for x in range(W):
                Y = Yp[y][x]
                Cb = Cbp[y // v][x // h]
                Cr = Crp[y // v][x // h]

                    Y = Y / 257.0
                    Cb = Cb / 257.0
                    Cr = Cr / 257.0
                rgb = inverse(int(round(Y)), int(round(Cb)), int(round(Cr)), y709, refbw)
                row.append(rgb)
            rgb_rows.append(row)
        maxval = 65535 if bits == 16 else 255
        scale = 257 if bits == 16 else 1
        ppm_path = os.path.join(PPM_DIR, name + '.ppm')
        with open(ppm_path, 'w') as f:
            f.write("P3\n")
            f.write("%d %d\n" % (W, H))
            f.write("%d\n" % maxval)
            for row in rgb_rows:
                for (r, g, b) in row:
                    f.write("%d %d %d\n" % (int(r * scale), int(g * scale), int(b * scale)))

    print("generated", len(specs), "ycbcr tiffs and pmps")


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate YCbCr test TIFFs (tests/ycbcr_images) and RGB ground-truth PPMs
(tests/reference_images) for issue #38. Deterministic; writes classic TIFF
(Compression=1, little-endian) and Netpbm ASCII PPM (P3) files."""

import os
import struct

TIF_DIR = "/home/daniel/tiffcraft/tests/ycbcr_images"
PPM_DIR = "/home/daniel/tiffcraft/tests/reference_images"
os.makedirs(TIF_DIR, exist_ok=True)
os.makedirs(PPM_DIR, exist_ok=True)

TYPE_SIZE = {1: 1, 2: 1, 3: 2, 4: 4, 5: 8, 6: 1, 7: 1, 8: 2, 9: 4, 10: 8, 11: 4, 12: 8}

Y601 = (0.299, 0.587, 0.114)
CB601 = (-0.168736, -0.331264, 0.5)
CR601 = (0.5, -0.418688, -0.081312)
Y709 = (0.2126, 0.7152, 0.0722)
CB709 = (-0.1146, -0.3854, 0.5)
CR709 = (0.5, -0.4187, -0.0812)


def clamp8(v):
    return 0 if v < 0 else (255 if v > 255 else int(v))


def forward(R, G, B, ycoef, ccoef, rcoef):
    Y = ycoef[0] * R + ycoef[1] * G + ycoef[2] * B
    Cb = ccoef[0] * R + ccoef[1] * G + ccoef[2] * B + 128
    Cr = rcoef[0] * R + rcoef[1] * G + rcoef[2] * B + 128
    return (clamp8(round(Y)), clamp8(round(Cb)), clamp8(round(Cr)))


def inverse(Y, Cb, Cr, y709, refbw):
    bY, wY, bCb, wCb, bCr, wCr = refbw
    nY = (Y - bY) / float(wY - bY)
    nCb = (Cb - bCb) / float(wCb - bCb)
    nCr = (Cr - bCr) / float(wCr - bCr)
    Ys = bY + nY * (wY - bY)
    Cbs = bCb + nCb * (wCb - bCb)
    Crs = bCr + nCr * (wCr - bCr)
    if y709:
        R = Ys + 1.574 * (Crs - 128)
        G = Ys - 0.328 * (Cbs - 128) - 0.672 * (Crs - 128)
        B = Ys + 1.84 * (Cbs - 128) - 0.084 * (Crs - 128)
    else:
        R = Ys + 1.402 * (Crs - 128)
        G = Ys - 0.344136 * (Cbs - 128) - 0.714136 * (Crs - 128)
        B = Ys + 1.772 * (Cbs - 128) - 0.081312 * (Crs - 128)
    return (clamp8(round(R)), clamp8(round(G)), clamp8(round(B)))


REF_DEFAULT = (0, 255, 0, 128, 0, 128)
REF_CUSTOM = (16, 239, 16, 112, 16, 112)


def source_pixels(case_idx, W, H):
    px = []
    for y in range(H):
        row = []
        for x in range(W):
            r = int((x * 37 + y * 91 + case_idx * 53) % 256)
            g = int((x * 17 + y * 29 + case_idx * 97) % 256)
            b = int((x * 7 + y * 13 + case_idx * 31) % 256)
            row.append((r, g, b))
        px.append(row)
    return px


def ycbcr_planes(src, W, H, h, v, ycoef, ccoef, rcoef, bits):
    ch = -(-H // v)
    cw = -(-W // h)
    Yp = [[0] * W for _ in range(H)]
    Cbp = [[0] * cw for _ in range(ch)]
    Crp = [[0] * cw for _ in range(ch)]
    for y in range(H):
        for x in range(W):
            r, g, b = src[y][x]
            Y, Cb, Cr = forward(r, g, b, ycoef, ccoef, rcoef)
            Yp[y][x] = Y
            if bits == 16:
                Y, Cb, Cr = Y * 257, Cb * 257, Cr * 257
            j = y // v
            i = x // h
            Cbp[j][i] = Cb
            Crp[j][i] = Cr
    return Yp, Cbp, Crp, cw, ch


def rationals(refbw):
    bY, wY, bCb, wCb, bCr, wCr = refbw
    vals = [(bY, 1), (wY, 1), (bCb, 1), (wCb, 1), (bCr, 1), (wCr, 1)]
    return b''.join(struct.pack('<II', n, d) for (n, d) in vals)


def coeffs_bytes(y709):
    y = Y709 if y709 else Y601
    return b''.join(struct.pack('<II', int(round(v * 10000)), 10000) for v in (y[0], y[1], y[2]))


def write_tiff(path, W, H, bits, h, v, positioning, planar, tiled, tile_size, Yp, Cbp, Crp, ch, refbw, y709):
    entries = []

    def add(tag, typ, count, raw):
        entries.append((tag, typ, count, raw))

    strip_data = b''
    strip_sizes = []
    strip_offsets = []
    tiled_offsets = []
    tiled_counts = []

    if tiled:
        ts = tile_size
        tiles = []
        ty = 0
        while ty < H:
            tx = 0
            while tx < W:
                y0, y1 = ty, min(ty + ts, H)
                x0, x1 = tx, min(tx + ts, W)
                buf = bytearray()
                for y in range(y0, y1):
                    for x in range(x0, x1):
                        if bits == 8:
                            buf += bytes([Yp[y][x], Cbp[y // v][x // h], Crp[y // v][x // h]])
                        else:
                            buf += struct.pack('<HHH', Yp[y][x], Cbp[y // v][x // h], Crp[y // v][x // h])
                tiles.append(bytes(buf))
                tx += ts
            ty += ts
        nt = len(tiles)
        tiled_counts = [len(t) for t in tiles]
        strip_data = b''.join(tiles)
        nstrips = nt
        add(256, 4, 1, struct.pack('<I', W))
        add(257, 4, 1, struct.pack('<I', H))
        add(258, 3, 3, struct.pack('<HHH', bits, bits, bits))
        add(259, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', 1))
        add(262, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', 6))
        add(277, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', 3))
        add(284, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', planar))
        add(317, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', 1))
        add(322, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', tile_size))
        add(323, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', tile_size))
        add(324, 4, nt, struct.pack('<' + 'I' * nt, *([0] * nt)))
        add(325, 4, nt, struct.pack('<' + 'I' * nt, *tiled_counts))
        add(339, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', 1))
        add(529, 5, 3, coeffs_bytes(y709))
        add(530, 3, 2, struct.pack('<HH', h, v))
        add(531, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', positioning))
        add(532, 5, 6, rationals(refbw))

    elif planar == 2:
        if bits == 8:
            s0 = bytes(bytearray([Yp[y][x] for y in range(H) for x in range(W)]))
            s1 = bytes(bytearray([Cbp[j][i] for j in range(ch) for i in range(len(Cbp[0]))]))
            s2 = bytes(bytearray([Crp[j][i] for j in range(ch) for i in range(len(Crp[0]))]))
        else:
            def pack_plane16(plane, rows, cols):
                out = bytearray()
                for j in range(rows):
                    for i in range(cols):
                        out += struct.pack('<HH', plane[j][i], plane[j][i])
                return bytes(out)
            s0 = pack_plane16(Yp, H, W)
            s1 = pack_plane16(Cbp, ch, len(Cbp[0]))
            s2 = pack_plane16(Crp, ch, len(Crp[0]))
        strip_data = s0 + s1 + s2
        strip_sizes = [len(s0), len(s1), len(s2)]
        nstrips = 3
        add(256, 4, 1, struct.pack('<I', W))
        add(257, 4, 1, struct.pack('<I', H))
        add(258, 3, 3, struct.pack('<HHH', bits, bits, bits))
        add(259, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', 1))
        add(262, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', 6))
        add(273, 4, 3, struct.pack('<' + 'I' * 3, *([0] * 3)))
        add(277, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', 3))
        add(278, 4, 1, struct.pack('<I', H))
        add(279, 4, 3, struct.pack('<' + 'I' * 3, *([0] * 3)))
        add(284, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', planar))
        add(317, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', 1))
        add(339, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', 1))
        add(529, 5, 3, coeffs_bytes(y709))
        add(530, 3, 2, struct.pack('<HH', h, v))
        add(531, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', positioning))
        add(532, 5, 6, rationals(refbw))

    if planar == 1:
        if bits == 8:
            sd = bytearray()
            for y in range(H):
                for x in range(W):
                    sd += bytes([Yp[y][x], Cbp[y // v][x // h], Crp[y // v][x // h]])
            strip_data = bytes(sd)
        else:
            sd = bytearray()
            for y in range(H):
                for x in range(W):
                    sd += struct.pack('<HHH', Yp[y][x], Cbp[y // v][x // h], Crp[y // v][x // h])
            strip_data = bytes(sd)
        strip_sizes = [len(strip_data)]
        nstrips = 1
        add(273, 4, 1, struct.pack('<I', 0))
        add(277, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', 3))
        add(278, 4, 1, struct.pack('<I', H))
        add(279, 4, 1, struct.pack('<I', len(strip_data)))
        add(284, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', planar))
        add(317, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', 1))
        add(339, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', 1))
        add(529, 5, 3, coeffs_bytes(y709))
        add(530, 3, 2, struct.pack('<HH', h, v))
        add(531, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', positioning))
        add(532, 5, 6, rationals(refbw))

    entries = sorted(entries, key=lambda e: e[0])
    n_entries = len(entries)

    ifd_size = 2 + 12 * n_entries + 4
    cur = 8 + ifd_size
    pos_map = {}
    for e in entries:
        size = TYPE_SIZE[e[1]] * e[2]
        if size > 4:
            if cur % 2 != 0:
                cur += 1
            pos_map[id(e)] = cur
            cur += size
    strip_off = cur
    strip_offsets = []
    off = strip_off
    for s in strip_sizes:
        strip_offsets.append(off)
        off += s

    entries2 = []
    for e in entries:
        tag, typ, count, raw = e
        if tag == 273:
            raw = struct.pack('<' + 'I' * count, *strip_offsets)
        if tag == 279:
            raw = struct.pack('<' + 'I' * count, *[strip_sizes[i] for i in range(count)])
        entries2.append((tag, typ, count, raw))
    entries = sorted(entries2, key=lambda e: e[0])
    n_entries = len(entries)

    ifd_size = 2 + 12 * n_entries + 4
    cur = 8 + ifd_size
    pos_map = {}
    for e in entries:
        size = TYPE_SIZE[e[1]] * e[2]
        if size > 4:
            if cur % 2 != 0:
                cur += 1
            pos_map[id(e)] = cur
            cur += size
    strip_off = cur

    buf = bytearray()
    buf += b'II' + struct.pack('<HI', 42, 8)
    buf += struct.pack('<H', n_entries)
    for e in entries:
        tag, typ, count, raw = e
        size = TYPE_SIZE[typ] * count
        if size <= 4:
            field = int.from_bytes(raw.ljust(4, b'\x00'), 'little')
        else:
            field = pos_map[id(e)]
        buf += struct.pack('<HHI', tag, typ, count) + struct.pack('<I', field)
    buf += struct.pack('<I', 0)
    for e in entries:
        tag, typ, count, raw = e
        size = TYPE_SIZE[typ] * count
        if size > 4:
            if len(buf) % 2 != 0:
                buf += b'\x00'
            buf += raw
    buf += strip_data
    with open(path, 'wb') as f:
        f.write(bytes(buf))


def write_ppm(path, W, H, rgb_rows, maxval):
    with open(path, 'w') as f:
        f.write("P3\n")
        f.write("%d %d\n" % (W, H))
        f.write("%d\n" % maxval)
        for row in rgb_rows:
            for (r, g, b) in row:
                f.write("%d %d %d\n" % (int(r), int(g), int(b)))


def main():
    specs = [
        # Subsampling coverage (all centered, default coeffs, default RefBW, chunky, Bits 8, 64x48)
        ("ycbcr-1x1",      64,  48, 1, 1, 1, 1, False, 16, 8, False, REF_DEFAULT),
        ("ycbcr-2x1",      64,  48, 2, 1, 1, 1, False, 16, 8, False, REF_DEFAULT),
        ("ycbcr-1x2",      64,  48, 1, 2, 1, 1, False, 16, 8, False, REF_DEFAULT),
        ("ycbcr-2x2",      64,  48, 2, 2, 1, 1, False, 16, 8, False, REF_DEFAULT),
        ("ycbcr-4x1",      64,  48, 4, 1, 1, 1, False, 16, 8, False, REF_DEFAULT),
        ("ycbcr-1x4",      64,  48, 1, 4, 1, 1, False, 16, 8, False, REF_DEFAULT),
        ("ycbcr-4x2",      64,  48, 4, 2, 1, 1, False, 16, 8, False, REF_DEFAULT),
        ("ycbcr-2x4",      64,  48, 2, 4, 1, 1, False, 16, 8, False, REF_DEFAULT),
        ("ycbcr-4x4",      64,  48, 4, 4, 1, 1, False, 16, 8, False, REF_DEFAULT),
        # Variants
        ("ycbcr-cosited",  64,  48, 2, 2, 2, 1, False, 16, 8, False, REF_DEFAULT),
        ("ycbcr-custom-coeffs", 64, 48, 1, 1, 1, 1, False, 16, 8, True, REF_DEFAULT),
        ("ycbcr-custom-refbw", 64, 48, 1, 1, 1, 1, False, 16, 8, False, REF_CUSTOM),
        ("ycbcr-planar-2x2", 64, 48, 2, 2, 1, 2, False, 16, 8, False, REF_DEFAULT),
        ("ycbcr-tiled-2x2", 64, 48, 2, 2, 1, 1, True, 16, 8, False, REF_DEFAULT),
        ("ycbcr-16bit-1x1", 64,  48, 1, 1, 1, 1, False, 16, 16, False, REF_DEFAULT),
        # Odd sizes
        ("ycbcr-odd-2x2",  61,  47, 2, 2, 1, 1, False, 16, 8, False, REF_DEFAULT),
        ("ycbcr-odd-4x4",  63,  61, 4, 4, 1, 1, False, 16, 8, False, REF_DEFAULT),
        ("ycbcr-odd-mixed", 62,  47, 2, 1, 1, 1, False, 16, 8, False, REF_DEFAULT),
    ]

    for idx, (name, W, H, h, v, positioning, planar, tiled, tile_size, bits, y709, refbw) in enumerate(specs):
        src = source_pixels(idx * 7 + 3, W, H)
        ycoef, ccoef, rcoef = (Y709, CB709, CR709) if y709 else (Y601, CB601, CR601)
        Yp, Cbp, Crp, cw, ch = ycbcr_planes(src, W, H, h, v, ycoef, ccoef, rcoef, bits)
        tif_path = os.path.join(TIF_DIR, name + '.tif')
        write_tiff(tif_path, W, H, bits, h, v, positioning, planar, tiled, tile_size, Yp, Cbp, Crp, ch, refbw, y709)

        rgb_rows = []
        for y in range(H):
            row = []
            for x in range(W):
                Y = Yp[y][x]
                Cb = Cbp[y // v][x // h]
                Cr = Crp[y // v][x // h]
                if bits == 16:
                    Y = Y / 257.0
                    Cb = Cb / 257.0
                    Cr = Cr / 257.0
                rgb = inverse(int(round(Y)), int(round(Cb)), int(round(Cr)), y709, refbw)
                row.append(rgb)
            rgb_rows.append(row)
        maxval = 65535 if bits == 16 else 255
        scale = 257 if bits == 16 else 1
        ppm_path = os.path.join(PPM_DIR, name + '.ppm')
        with open(ppm_path, 'w') as f:
            f.write("P3\n")
            f.write("%d %d\n" % (W, H))
            f.write("%d\n" % maxval)
            for row in rgb_rows:
                for (r, g, b) in row:
                    f.write("%d %d %d\n" % (int(r * scale), int(g * scale), int(b * scale)))

    print("generated", len(specs), "ycbcr tiffs and pmps")


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate YCbCr test TIFFs (tests/ycbcr_images) and RGB ground-truth PPMs
(tests/reference_images) for issue #38. Deterministic; writes classic TIFF
(Compression=1, little-endian) and Netpbm ASCII PPM (P3) files."""

import os
import struct

TIF_DIR = "/home/daniel/tiffcraft/tests/ycbcr_images"
PPM_DIR = "/home/daniel/tiffcraft/tests/reference_images"
os.makedirs(TIF_DIR, exist_ok=True)
os.makedirs(PPM_DIR, exist_ok=True)

TYPE_SIZE = {1: 1, 2: 1, 3: 2, 4: 4, 5: 8, 6: 1, 7: 1, 8: 2, 9: 4, 10: 8, 11: 4, 12: 8}

Y601 = (0.299, 0.587, 0.114)
CB601 = (-0.168736, -0.331264, 0.5)
CR601 = (0.5, -0.418688, -0.081312)
Y709 = (0.2126, 0.7152, 0.0722)
CB709 = (-0.1146, -0.3854, 0.5)
CR709 = (0.5, -0.4187, -0.0812)


def clamp8(v):
    return 0 if v < 0 else (255 if v > 255 else int(v))


def forward(R, G, B, ycoef, ccoef, rcoef):
    Y = ycoef[0] * R + ycoef[1] * G + ycoef[2] * B
    Cb = ccoef[0] * R + ccoef[1] * G + ccoef[2] * B + 128
    Cr = rcoef[0] * R + rcoef[1] * G + rcoef[2] * B + 128
    return (clamp8(round(Y)), clamp8(round(Cb)), clamp8(round(Cr)))


def inverse(Y, Cb, Cr, y709, refbw):
    bY, wY, bCb, wCb, bCr, wCr = refbw
    nY = (Y - bY) / float(wY - bY)
    nCb = (Cb - bCb) / float(wCb - bCb)
    nCr = (Cr - bCr) / float(wCr - bCr)
    Ys = bY + nY * (wY - bY)
    Cbs = bCb + nCb * (wCb - bCb)
    Crs = bCr + nCr * (wCr - bCr)
    if y709:
        R = Ys + 1.574 * (Crs - 128)
        G = Ys - 0.328 * (Cbs - 128) - 0.672 * (Crs - 128)
        B = Ys + 1.84 * (Cbs - 128) - 0.084 * (Crs - 128)
    else:
        R = Ys + 1.402 * (Crs - 128)
        G = Ys - 0.344136 * (Cbs - 128) - 0.714136 * (Crs - 128)
        B = Ys + 1.772 * (Cbs - 128) - 0.081312 * (Crs - 128)
    return (clamp8(round(R)), clamp8(round(G)), clamp8(round(B)))


REF_DEFAULT = (0, 255, 0, 128, 0, 128)
REF_CUSTOM = (16, 239, 16, 112, 16, 112)


def source_pixels(case_idx, W, H):
    px = []
    for y in range(H):
        row = []
        for x in range(W):
            r = int((x * 37 + y * 91 + case_idx * 53) % 256)
            g = int((x * 17 + y * 29 + case_idx * 97) % 256)
            b = int((x * 7 + y * 13 + case_idx * 31) % 256)
            row.append((r, g, b))
        px.append(row)
    return px


def ycbcr_planes(src, W, H, h, v, ycoef, ccoef, rcoef, bits):
    ch = -(-H // v)
    cw = -(-W // h)
    Yp = [[0] * W for _ in range(H)]
    Cbp = [[0] * cw for _ in range(ch)]
    Crp = [[0] * cw for _ in range(ch)]
    for y in range(H):
        for x in range(W):
            r, g, b = src[y][x]
            Y, Cb, Cr = forward(r, g, b, ycoef, ccoef, rcoef)
            Yp[y][x] = Y
            if bits == 16:
                Y, Cb, Cr = Y * 257, Cb * 257, Cr * 257
            Cbp[y // v][x // h] = Cb
            Crp[y // v][x // h] = Cr
    return Yp, Cbp, Crp, cw, ch


def rationals(refbw):
    bY, wY, bCb, wCb, bCr, wCr = refbw
    vals = [(bY, 1), (wY, 1), (bCb, 1), (wCb, 1), (bCr, 1), (wCr, 1)]
    return b''.join(struct.pack('<II', n, d) for (n, d) in vals)


def coeffs_bytes(y709):
    y = Y709 if y709 else Y601
    return b''.join(struct.pack('<II', int(round(v * 10000)), 10000) for v in (y[0], y[1], y[2]))


def write_tiff(path, W, H, bits, h, v, positioning, planar, tiled, tile_size, Yp, Cbp, Crp, ch, refbw, y709):

    def add(tag, typ, count, raw):
        entries.append((tag, typ, count, raw))

    strip_data = b''
    strip_sizes = []
    nstrips = 0

        tiles = []
        ty = 0
        while ty < H:
            tx = 0
            while tx < W:
                y0, y1 = ty, min(ty + ts, H)
                x0, x1 = tx, min(tx + ts, W)

                luma_cols = x1 - x0
                cb_r = -(-y1 // v) - (y0 // v) if v > 1 else luma_rows

                buf = bytearray()

                for j in range(y0 // v, -(-y1 // v)):

                tiles.append(bytes(buf))

        strip_data = b''.join(tiles)

        add(256, 4, 1, struct.pack('<I', W))
        add(257, 4, 1, struct.pack('<I', H))

        add(262, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', 6))
        add(277, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', 3))
        add(284, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', planar))
        add(317, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', 1))
        add(322, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', tile_size))
        add(323, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', tile_size))

        add(529, 5, 3, coeffs_bytes(y709))
        add(530, 3, 2, struct.pack('<HH', h, v))
        add(531, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', positioning))
        add(532, 5, 6, rationals(refbw))

    elif planar == 2:

        strip_sizes = [len(s0), len(s1), len(s2)]
        nstrips = 3
        add(256, 4, 1, struct.pack('<I', W))
        add(257, 4, 1, struct.pack('<I', H))
        add(258, 3, 3, struct.pack('<HHH', bits, bits, bits))
        add(259, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', 1))

        add(317, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', 1))
        add(339, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', 1))
        add(529, 5, 3, coeffs_bytes(y709))
        add(530, 3, 2, struct.pack('<HH', h, v))
        add(531, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', positioning))
        add(532, 5, 6, rationals(refbw))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate YCbCr test TIFFs (tests/ycbcr_images) and RGB ground-truth PPMs
(tests/reference_images) for issue #38. Deterministic; writes classic TIFF
(Compression=1, little-endian) and Netpbm ASCII PPM (P3) files."""

import os
import struct

TIF_DIR = "/home/daniel/tiffcraft/tests/ycbcr_images"
PPM_DIR = "/home/daniel/tiffcraft/tests/reference_images"
os.makedirs(TIF_DIR, exist_ok=True)
os.makedirs(PPM_DIR, exist_ok=True)

TYPE_SIZE = {1: 1, 2: 1, 3: 2, 4: 4, 5: 8, 6: 1, 7: 1, 8: 2, 9: 4, 10: 8, 11: 4, 12: 8}

Y601 = (0.299, 0.587, 0.114)
CB601 = (-0.168736, -0.331264, 0.5)
CR601 = (0.5, -0.418688, -0.081312)
Y709 = (0.2126, 0.7152, 0.0722)
CB709 = (-0.1146, -0.3854, 0.5)
CR709 = (0.5, -0.4187, -0.0812)


def clamp8(v):
    return 0 if v < 0 else (255 if v > 255 else int(v))


def forward(R, G, B, ycoef, ccoef, rcoef):
    Y = ycoef[0] * R + ycoef[1] * G + ycoef[2] * B
    Cb = ccoef[0] * R + ccoef[1] * G + ccoef[2] * B + 128
    Cr = rcoef[0] * R + rcoef[1] * G + rcoef[2] * B + 128
    return (clamp8(round(Y)), clamp8(round(Cb)), clamp8(round(Cr)))


def inverse(Y, Cb, Cr, y709, refbw):
    bY, wY, bCb, wCb, bCr, wCr = refbw
    nY = (Y - bY) / float(wY - bY)
    nCb = (Cb - bCb) / float(wCb - bCb)
    nCr = (Cr - bCr) / float(wCr - bCr)
    Ys = bY + nY * (wY - bY)
    Cbs = bCb + nCb * (wCb - bCb)
    Crs = bCr + nCr * (wCr - bCr)
    if y709:
        R = Ys + 1.574 * (Crs - 128)
        G = Ys - 0.328 * (Cbs - 128) - 0.672 * (Crs - 128)
        B = Ys + 1.84 * (Cbs - 128) - 0.084 * (Crs - 128)
    else:
        R = Ys + 1.402 * (Crs - 128)
        G = Ys - 0.344136 * (Cbs - 128) - 0.714136 * (Crs - 128)
        B = Ys + 1.772 * (Cbs - 128) - 0.081312 * (Crs - 128)
    return (clamp8(round(R)), clamp8(round(G)), clamp8(round(B)))


REF_DEFAULT = (0, 255, 0, 128, 0, 128)
REF_CUSTOM = (16, 239, 16, 112, 16, 112)


def source_pixels(case_idx, W, H):
    px = []
    for y in range(H):
        row = []
        for x in range(W):
            r = int((x * 37 + y * 91 + case_idx * 53) % 256)
            g = int((x * 17 + y * 29 + case_idx * 97) % 256)
            b = int((x * 7 + y * 13 + case_idx * 31) % 256)
            row.append((r, g, b))
        px.append(row)
    return px


def ycbcr_planes(src, W, H, h, v, ycoef, ccoef, rcoef, bits):
    ch = -(-H // v)
    cw = -(-W // h)
    Yp = [[0] * W for _ in range(H)]
    Cbp = [[0] * cw for _ in range(ch)]
    Crp = [[0] * cw for _ in range(ch)]
    for y in range(H):
        for x in range(W):
            r, g, b = src[y][x]
            Y, Cb, Cr = forward(r, g, b, ycoef, ccoef, rcoef)
            Yp[y][x] = Y
            if bits == 16:
                Y, Cb, Cr = Y * 257, Cb * 257, Cr * 257
            Cbp[y // v][x // h] = Cb
            Crp[y // v][x // h] = Cr
    return Yp, Cbp, Crp, cw, ch


def rationals(refbw):
    bY, wY, bCb, wCb, bCr, wCr = refbw
    vals = [(bY, 1), (wY, 1), (bCb, 1), (wCb, 1), (bCr, 1), (wCr, 1)]
    return b''.join(struct.pack('<II', n, d) for (n, d) in vals)


def coeffs_bytes(y709):
    y = Y709 if y709 else Y601
    return b''.join(struct.pack('<II', int(round(v * 10000)), 10000) for v in (y[0], y[1], y[2]))


def write_tiff(path, W, H, bits, h, v, positioning, planar, tiled, tile_size, Yp, Cbp, Crp, ch, refbw, y709):
    entries = []

    def add(tag, typ, count, raw):
        entries.append((tag, typ, count, raw))

    strip_data = b''
    strip_sizes = []
    nstrips = 0

    if tiled:
        ts = tile_size
        tiles = []
        ty = 0
        while ty < H:
            tx = 0
            while tx < W:
                y0, y1 = ty, min(ty + ts, H)
                x0, x1 = tx, min(tx + ts, W)
                luma_rows = y1 - y0
                luma_cols = x1 - x0
                cb_r = -(-y1 // v) - (y0 // v) if v > 1 else luma_rows
                cb_r = max(1, -(-y1 // v) - (y0 // v)) if v > 1 else luma_rows
                cb_c = -(-x1 // h) - (x0 // h) if h > 1 else luma_cols
                buf = bytearray()
                for y in range(y0, y1):
                    buf += bytes([Yp[y][x] for x in range(x0, x1)])
                for j in range(y0 // v, -(-y1 // v)):
                    buf += bytes([Cbp[j][i] for i in range(x0 // h, -(-x1 // h))])
                for j in range(y0 // v, -(-y1 // v)):
                    buf += bytes([Crp[j][i] for i in range(x0 // h, -(-x1 // h))])
                tiles.append(bytes(buf))
                tx += ts
            ty += ts
        nt = len(tiles)
        tiled_counts = [len(t) for t in tiles]
        strip_data = b''.join(tiles)
        strip_sizes = tiled_counts
        nstrips = nt
        add(256, 4, 1, struct.pack('<I', W))
        add(257, 4, 1, struct.pack('<I', H))
        add(258, 3, 3, struct.pack('<HHH', bits, bits, bits))
        add(259, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', 1))
        add(262, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', 6))
        add(277, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', 3))
        add(284, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', planar))
        add(317, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', 1))
        add(322, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', tile_size))
        add(323, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', tile_size))
        add(324, 4, nt, struct.pack('<' + 'I' * nt, *([0] * nt)))
        add(325, 4, nt, struct.pack('<' + 'I' * nt, *tiled_counts))
        add(339, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', 1))
        add(529, 5, 3, coeffs_bytes(y709))
        add(530, 3, 2, struct.pack('<HH', h, v))
        add(531, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', positioning))
        add(532, 5, 6, rationals(refbw))

    elif planar == 2:
        if bits == 8:
            s0 = bytes(bytearray([Yp[y][x] for y in range(H) for x in range(W)]))
            s1 = bytes(bytearray([Cbp[j][i] for j in range(ch) for i in range(cw)]))
            s2 = bytes(bytearray([Crp[j][i] for j in range(ch) for i in range(cw)]))
        else:
            def pack_plane16(plane, rows, cols):
                out = bytearray()
                for j in range(rows):
                    for i in range(cols):
                        out += struct.pack('<HH', plane[j][i], plane[j][i])
                return bytes(out)
            s0 = pack_plane16(Yp, H, W)
            s1 = pack_plane16(Cbp, ch, cw)
            s2 = pack_plane16(Crp, ch, cw)
        strip_data = s0 + s1 + s2
        strip_sizes = [len(s0), len(s1), len(s2)]
        nstrips = 3
        add(256, 4, 1, struct.pack('<I', W))
        add(257, 4, 1, struct.pack('<I', H))
        add(258, 3, 3, struct.pack('<HHH', bits, bits, bits))
        add(259, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', 1))
        add(262, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', 6))
        add(273, 4, 3, struct.pack('<' + 'I' * 3, *([0] * 3)))
        add(277, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', 3))
        add(278, 4, 1, struct.pack('<I', H))
        add(279, 4, 3, struct.pack('<' + 'I' * 3, *([0] * 3)))
        add(284, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', planar))
        add(317, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', 1))
        add(339, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', 1))
        add(529, 5, 3, coeffs_bytes(y709))
        add(530, 3, 2, struct.pack('<HH', h, v))
        add(531, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', positioning))
        add(532, 5, 6, rationals(refbw))

    elif planar == 1:
        if bits == 8:
            sd = bytearray()
            for y in range(H):
                sd += bytes([Yp[y][x] for x in range(W)])
            for j in range(ch):
                sd += bytes([Cbp[j][i] for i in range(cw)])
            for j in range(ch):
                sd += bytes([Crp[j][i] for i in range(cw)])
            strip_data = bytes(sd)
        else:
            sd = bytearray()
            for y in range(H):
                for x in range(W):
                    sd += struct.pack('<HH', Yp[y][x], Yp[y][x])
            for j in range(ch):
                for i in range(cw):
                    sd += struct.pack('<HH', Cbp[j][i], Cbp[j][i])
            for j in range(ch):
                for i in range(cw):
                    sd += struct.pack('<HH', Crp[j][i], Crp[j][i])
            strip_data = bytes(sd)
        strip_sizes = [len(strip_data)]
        nstrips = 1
        add(256, 4, 1, struct.pack('<I', W))
        add(257, 4, 1, struct.pack('<I', H))
        add(258, 3, 3, struct.pack('<HHH', bits, bits, bits))
        add(259, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', 1))
        add(262, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', 6))
        add(273, 4, 1, struct.pack('<I', 0))
        add(277, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', 3))
        add(278, 4, 1, struct.pack('<I', H))
        add(279, 4, 1, struct.pack('<I', len(strip_data)))
        add(284, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', planar))
        add(317, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', 1))
        add(339, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', 1))
        add(529, 5, 3, coeffs_bytes(y709))
        add(530, 3, 2, struct.pack('<HH', h, v))
        add(531, 3, 1, struct.pack('<H', positioning))
        add(532, 5, 6, rationals(refbw))

    entries = sorted(entries, key=lambda e: e[0])
    n_entries = len(entries)

    ifd_size = 2 + 12 * n_entries + 4
    cur = 8 + ifd_size
    pos_map = {}
    for e in entries:
        size = TYPE_SIZE[e[1]] * e[2]
        if size > 4:
            if cur % 2 != 0:
                cur += 1
            pos_map[id(e)] = cur
            cur += size
    strip_off = cur
    strip_offsets = []
    off = strip_off
    for s in strip_sizes:
        strip_offsets.append(off)
        off += s

    entries2 = []
    for e in entries:
        tag, typ, count, raw = e
        if tag == 273:
            raw = struct.pack('<' + 'I' * count, *strip_offsets)
        if tag == 279:
            raw = struct.pack('<' + 'I' * count, *[strip_sizes[i] for i in range(count)])
        if tag == 324:
            raw = struct.pack('<' + 'I' * count, *strip_offsets)
        if tag == 325:
            raw = struct.pack('<' + 'I' * count, *[strip_sizes[i] for i in range(count)])
        entries2.append((tag, typ, count, raw))
    entries = sorted(entries2, key=lambda e: e[0])
    n_entries = len(entries)

    ifd_size = 2 + 12 * n_entries + 4
    cur = 8 + ifd_size
    pos_map = {}
    for e in entries:
        size = TYPE_SIZE[e[1]] * e[2]
        if size > 4:
            if cur % 2 != 0:
                cur += 1
            pos_map[id(e)] = cur
            cur += size
    strip_off = cur

    buf = bytearray()
    buf += b'II' + struct.pack('<HI', 42, 8)
    buf += struct.pack('<H', n_entries)
    for e in entries:
        tag, typ, count, raw = e
        size = TYPE_SIZE[typ] * count
        if size <= 4:
            field = int.from_bytes(raw.ljust(4, b'\x00'), 'little')
        else:
            field = pos_map[id(e)]
        buf += struct.pack('<HHI', tag, typ, count) + struct.pack('<I', field)
    buf += struct.pack('<I', 0)
    for e in entries:
        tag, typ, count, raw = e
        size = TYPE_SIZE[typ] * count
        if size > 4:
            if len(buf) % 2 != 0:
                buf += b'\x00'
            buf += raw
    buf += strip_data
    with open(path, 'wb') as f:
        f.write(bytes(buf))


def write_ppm(path, W, H, rgb_rows, maxval):
    with open(path, 'w') as f:
        f.write("P3\n")
        f.write("%d %d\n" % (W, H))
        f.write("%d\n" % maxval)
        for row in rgb_rows:
            for (r, g, b) in row:
                f.write("%d %d %d\n" % (int(r), int(g), int(b)))


def main():
    specs = [
        # Subsampling coverage (all centered, default coeffs, default RefBW, chunky, Bits 8, 64x48)
        ("ycbcr-1x1",      64,  48, 1, 1, 1, 1, False, 16, 8, False, REF_DEFAULT),
        ("ycbcr-2x1",      64,  48, 2, 1, 1, 1, False, 16, 8, False, REF_DEFAULT),
        ("ycbcr-1x2",      64,  48, 1, 2, 1, 1, False, 16, 8, False, REF_DEFAULT),
        ("ycbcr-2x2",      64,  48, 2, 2, 1, 1, False, 16, 8, False, REF_DEFAULT),
        ("ycbcr-4x1",      64,  48, 4, 1, 1, 1, False, 16, 8, False, REF_DEFAULT),
        ("ycbcr-1x4",      64,  48, 1, 4, 1, 1, False, 16, 8, False, REF_DEFAULT),
        ("ycbcr-4x2",      64,  48, 4, 2, 1, 1, False, 16, 8, False, REF_DEFAULT),
        ("ycbcr-2x4",      64,  48, 2, 4, 1, 1, False, 16, 8, False, REF_DEFAULT),
        ("ycbcr-4x4",      64,  48, 4, 4, 1, 1, False, 16, 8, False, REF_DEFAULT),
        # Variants
        ("ycbcr-cosited",  64,  48, 2, 2, 2, 1, False, 16, 8, False, REF_DEFAULT),
        ("ycbcr-custom-coeffs", 64, 48, 1, 1, 1, 1, False, 16, 8, True, REF_DEFAULT),
        ("ycbcr-custom-refbw", 64, 48, 1, 1, 1, 1, False, 16, 8, False, REF_CUSTOM),
        ("ycbcr-planar-2x2", 64, 48, 2, 2, 1, 2, False, 16, 8, False, REF_DEFAULT),
        ("ycbcr-tiled-2x2", 64, 48, 2, 2, 1, 1, True, 16, 8, False, REF_DEFAULT),
        ("ycbcr-16bit-1x1", 64,  48, 1, 1, 1, 1, False, 16, 16, False, REF_DEFAULT),
        # Odd sizes
        ("ycbcr-odd-2x2",  61,  47, 2, 2, 1, 1, False, 16, 8, False, REF_DEFAULT),
        ("ycbcr-odd-4x4",  63,  61, 4, 4, 1, 1, False, 16, 8, False, REF_DEFAULT),
        ("ycbcr-odd-mixed", 62,  47, 2, 1, 1, 1, False, 16, 8, False, REF_DEFAULT),
    ]

    for idx, (name, W, H, h, v, positioning, planar, tiled, tile_size, bits, y709, refbw) in enumerate(specs):
        src = source_pixels(idx * 7 + 3, W, H)
        ycoef, ccoef, rcoef = (Y709, CB709, CR709) if y709 else (Y601, CB601, CR601)
        Yp, Cbp, Crp, cw, ch = ycbcr_planes(src, W, H, h, v, ycoef, ccoef, rcoef, bits)
        tif_path = os.path.join(TIF_DIR, name + '.tif')
        write_tiff(tif_path, W, H, bits, h, v, positioning, planar, tiled, tile_size, Yp, Cbp, Crp, ch, refbw, y709)

        rgb_rows = []
        for y in range(H):
            row = []
            for x in range(W):
                Y = Yp[y][x]
                Cb = Cbp[y // v][x // h]
                Cr = Crp[y // v][x // h]
                if bits == 16:
                    Y = Y / 257.0
                    Cb = Cb / 257.0
                    Cr = Cr / 257.0
                rgb = inverse(int(round(Y)), int(round(Cb)), int(round(Cr)), y709, refbw)
                row.append(rgb)
            rgb_rows.append(row)
        maxval = 65535 if bits == 16 else 255
        scale = 257 if bits == 16 else 1
        ppm_path = os.path.join(PPM_DIR, name + '.ppm')
        with open(ppm_path, 'w') as f:
            f.write("P3\n")
            f.write("%d %d\n" % (W, H))
            f.write("%d\n" % maxval)
            for row in rgb_rows:
                for (r, g, b) in row:
                    f.write("%d %d %d\n" % (int(r * scale), int(g * scale), int(b * scale)))

    print("generated", len(specs), "ycbcr tiffs and pmps")


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

# YCbCr (PhotometricInterpretation = 6) Support Reference

This document is the **pure TIFF 6.0 specification reference** for YCbCr
(`PhotometricInterpretation = 6`) images, prepared as test data and
documentation for the YCbCr effort tracked in issue #37
("Add YCbCr (PI=6) support to TiffExporter") and its child issue #38
("YCbCr test coverage: documentation, test images, and reference data").

It intentionally contains **no TiffCraft implementation details**; it describes
the format only, so that the implementation (and its tests) can be validated
against the published TIFF 6.0 behavior.

## Scope

- YCbCr image encoding as defined by the TIFF 6.0 specification.
- Conversion between RGB and YCbCr.
- Chroma subsampling, positioning, and reference black/white handling.
- Minimum requirements for a valid YCbCr TIFF.
- Mapping of the generated test images in `tests/ycbcr_images/` to the
  specification topics they exercise.

## Tag definitions

The following TIFF tags describe the color information of an image whose
`PhotometricInterpretation = 6` (YCbCr).

| Tag | Name | TIFF value | Type | Count | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 529 | YCbCrCoefficients | 0x0211 | RATIONAL (5) / SRATIONAL (10) | 3 | ITU-R BT.601 luma coefficients | Coefficients used for the transformation from RGB to YCbCr. |
| 530 | YCbCrSubsampling | 0x0212 | SHORT (3) | 2 | 1, 1 | Horizontal and vertical subsampling factors of the chroma components. |
| 531 | YCbCrPositioning | 0x0213 | SHORT (3) | 1 | 1 | Positioning of the chroma samples relative to the luminance samples. |
| 532 | ReferenceBlackWhite | 0x0214 | RATIONAL (5) | 6 | (0, 255, 0, 128, 0, 128) | Reference black and white data values (headroom/footroom) per component. |

Notes on the individual tags:

- **YCbCrCoefficients (529 / 0x0211):** Type RATIONAL (TIFF data type 5) or
  SRATIONAL (TIFF data type 10), with **3 values** (the RGB -> YCbCr
  transformation coefficients, e.g. the luma row). Defaults to the ITU-R BT.601
  coefficients (approximately 0.299, 0.587, 0.114 for the red, green and blue
  contributions to luma).
- **YCbCrSubsampling (530 / 0x0212):** Type SHORT (TIFF data type 3), **2
  values** — the horizontal subsampling factor and the vertical subsampling
  factor. Default is **1, 1** (no subsampling). Legal factors are **1, 2 and 4**
  (1 = no subsampling, 2 = half resolution, 4 = quarter resolution along the
  axis).
- **YCbCrPositioning (531 / 0x0213):** Type SHORT (TIFF data type 3), **1
  value**. Default is **1 = centered**. The alternative value is **2 = co-sited**
  (chroma sample points aligned with luma sample positions, as used e.g. in
  broadcast 4:2:2 workflows).
- **ReferenceBlackWhite (532 / 0x0214):** Type RATIONAL (TIFF data type 5), **6
  values**. The values are grouped in pairs of (reference black, reference
  white) per pixel component, ordered like the components of the
  `PhotometricInterpretation = 6` image (Y, Cb, Cr). Default value set:
  Y black/white = 0/255, Cb black/white = 0/128, Cr black/white = 0/128.

## Conversion formulas

### Forward conversion (RGB -> YCbCr), ITU-R BT.601

- `Y  = 0.299 * R + 0.587 * G + 0.114 * B`
- `Cb = -0.168736 * R - 0.331264 * G + 0.5 * B + 128`
- `Cr = 0.5 * R - 0.418688 * G - 0.081312 * B + 128`

### Reverse conversion (YCbCr -> RGB), ITU-R BT.601

- `R = Y + 1.402 * (Cr - 128)`
- `G = Y - 0.344136 * (Cb - 128) - 0.714136 * (Cr - 128)`
- `B = Y + 1.772 * (Cb - 128) - 0.081312 * (Cr - 128)`

### Reference black/white / headroom and footroom

The `ReferenceBlackWhite` tag supplies, per component, a reference black value
and a reference white value. These define the headroom/footroom range of the
image data: the black value corresponds to the black end of the coding range and
the white value to the white end, allowing scaling of the YCbCr codes into the
full data range when converting to RGB.

For YCbCr the default reference values are black = 0 and white = 255 for the
luma component (Y), and black = 0 and white = 128 for the chroma components
(Cb/Cr).

## Subsampling

- The `YCbCrSubsampling` factors describe how the chroma components are
  subsampled relative to the luma component.
- Subsampling factors of **1, 2 and 4** are the ones covered by the generated
  test images.
- The chroma image dimensions are computed by rounding **up** (ceiling) the
  luma dimensions divided by the subsampling factor, so that no chroma sample is
  dropped for images whose dimensions are not evenly divisible.
- For images using subsampling, strip organization (`RowsPerStrip`) must be
  consistent with the luma/chroma grid; a single strip per image (or rows per
  strip expressed in luma rows) is used by the generated test images.

## Positioning

- `YCbCrPositioning = 1` (default): **centered** positioning of the chroma
  samples with respect to the luminance samples.
- `YCbCrPositioning = 2`: **co-sited** positioning (chroma sample points aligned
  with luma sample points, e.g. recommended for 4:2:2 workflows).

## Minimum requirements for YCbCr images

In addition to the general Baseline TIFF requirements, a YCbCr file must have:

- `SamplesPerPixel = 3` (Y, Cb, Cr).
- `BitsPerSample = 8, 8, 8`.
- `Compression = 1` (none), `5` (LZW) or `7` (JPEG; TIFF Technical Note 2).
- `PhotometricInterpretation = 6` (YCbCr).
- `PlanarConfig = 1` (chunky) or `2` (separate).

## Test image matrix

The generated test images under `tests/ycbcr_images/` and the corresponding
ground-truth RGB images under `tests/reference_images/`.

### Subsampling coverage (all centered, default coefficients, default
`ReferenceBlackWhite`, chunky, BitsPerSample 8, base image 64x48)

| `ycbcr-1x1.tif` | 1x1 | centered (1) | default | default | chunky | 8 | 64x48 | No subsampling; full-resolution YCbCr. |
| `ycbcr-2x1.tif` | 2x1 | centered (1) | default | default | chunky | 8 | 64x48 | Horizontal subsampling factor 2. |
| `ycbcr-1x2.tif` | 1x2 | centered (1) | default | default | chunky | 8 | 64x48 | Vertical subsampling factor 2. |

| `ycbcr-4x1.tif` | 4x1 | centered (1) | default | default | chunky | 8 | 64x48 | Horizontal subsampling factor 4. |
| `ycbcr-1x4.tif` | 1x4 | centered (1) | default | default | chunky | 8 | 64x48 | Vertical subsampling factor 4. |
| `ycbcr-4x2.tif` | 4x2 | centered (1) | default | default | chunky | 8 | 64x48 | Combined subsampling factors 4 and 2. |
| `ycbcr-2x4.tif` | 2x4 | centered (1) | default | default | chunky | 8 | 64x48 | Combined subsampling factors 2 and 4. |
| `ycbcr-4x4.tif` | 4x4 | centered (1) | default | default | chunky | 8 | 64x48 | Maximum subsampling factor 4 on both axes. |

### Variants

| Test image | Subsampling (h x v) | Positioning | Coefficients | RefBW | Planar | Bits | Dimensions | Validates |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ycbcr-cosited.tif` | 2x2 | co-sited (2) | default | default | chunky | 8 | 64x48 | Co-sited positioning with subsampling. |
| `ycbcr-custom-coeffs.tif` | 1x1 | centered (1) | custom | default | chunky | 8 | 64x48 | Non-default YCbCr coefficients (BT.709). |
| `ycbcr-custom-refbw.tif` | 1x1 | centered (1) | default | custom | chunky | 8 | 64x48 | Non-default reference black/white values. |
| `ycbcr-planar-2x2.tif` | 2x2 | centered (1) | default | default | separate | 8 | 64x48 | Separate planar configuration (PlanarConfig=2). |
| `ycbcr-tiled-2x2.tif` | 2x2 | centered (1) | default | default | chunky (tiled) | 8 | 64x48 | Tiled image organization. |
| `ycbcr-16bit-1x1.tif` | 1x1 | centered (1) | default | default | chunky | 16 | 64x48 | 16 bits per sample YCbCr. |

### Odd (non-divisible) dimensions

| Test image | Subsampling (h x v) | Positioning | Coefficients | RefBW | Planar | Bits | Dimensions | Validates |

# YCbCr (PhotometricInterpretation = 6) Support Reference

This document is the **pure TIFF 6.0 specification reference** for YCbCr
(`PhotometricInterpretation = 6`) images, prepared as test data and
documentation for the YCbCr effort tracked in issue #37
("Add YCbCr (PI=6) support to TiffExporter") and its child issue #38
("YCbCr test coverage: documentation, test images, and reference data").

It intentionally contains **no TiffCraft implementation details**; it describes
the format only, so that the implementation (and its tests) can be validated
against the published TIFF 6.0 behavior.

## Scope

- YCbCr image encoding as defined by the TIFF 6.0 specification.
- Conversion between RGB and YCbCr.
- Chroma subsampling, positioning, and reference black/white handling.
- Minimum requirements for a valid YCbCr TIFF.
- Mapping of the generated test images in `tests/ycbcr_images/` to the
  specification topics they exercise.

## Tag definitions

The following TIFF tags describe the color information of an image whose
`PhotometricInterpretation = 6` (YCbCr).

| Tag | Name | TIFF value | Type | Count | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 529 | YCbCrCoefficients | 0x0211 | RATIONAL (5) / SRATIONAL (10) | 3 | ITU-R BT.601 luma coefficients | Coefficients used for the transformation from RGB to YCbCr. |
| 530 | YCbCrSubsampling | 0x0212 | SHORT (3) | 2 | 1, 1 | Horizontal and vertical subsampling factors of the chroma components. |
| 531 | YCbCrPositioning | 0x0213 | SHORT (3) | 1 | 1 | Positioning of the chroma samples relative to the luminance samples. |
| 532 | ReferenceBlackWhite | 0x0214 | RATIONAL (5) | 6 | (0, 255, 0, 128, 0, 128) | Reference black and white data values (headroom/footroom) per component. |

Notes on the individual tags:

- **YCbCrCoefficients (529 / 0x0211):** Type RATIONAL (TIFF data type 5) or
  SRATIONAL (TIFF data type 10), with **3 values** (the RGB -> YCbCr
  transformation coefficients, e.g. the luma row). Defaults to the ITU-R BT.601
  coefficients (approximately 0.299, 0.587, 0.114 for the red, green and blue
  contributions to luma).
- **YCbCrSubsampling (530 / 0x0212):** Type SHORT (TIFF data type 3), **2
  values** — the horizontal subsampling factor and the vertical subsampling
  factor. Default is **1, 1** (no subsampling). Legal factors are **1, 2 and 4**
  (1 = no subsampling, 2 = half resolution, 4 = quarter resolution along the
  axis).
- **YCbCrPositioning (531 / 0x0213):** Type SHORT (TIFF data type 3), **1
  value**. Default is **1 = centered**. The alternative value is **2 = co-sited**
  (chroma sample points aligned with luma sample positions, as used e.g. in
  broadcast 4:2:2 workflows).
- **ReferenceBlackWhite (532 / 0x0214):** Type RATIONAL (TIFF data type 5), **6
  values**. The values are grouped in pairs of (reference black, reference
  white) per pixel component, ordered like the components of the
  `PhotometricInterpretation = 6` image (Y, Cb, Cr). Default value set:
  Y black/white = 0/255, Cb black/white = 0/128, Cr black/white = 0/128.

## Conversion formulas

### Forward conversion (RGB -> YCbCr), ITU-R BT.601

- `Y  = 0.299 * R + 0.587 * G + 0.114 * B`
- `Cb = -0.168736 * R - 0.331264 * G + 0.5 * B + 128`
- `Cr = 0.5 * R - 0.418688 * G - 0.081312 * B + 128`

### Reverse conversion (YCbCr -> RGB), ITU-R BT.601

- `R = Y + 1.402 * (Cr - 128)`
- `G = Y - 0.344136 * (Cb - 128) - 0.714136 * (Cr - 128)`
- `B = Y + 1.772 * (Cb - 128) - 0.081312 * (Cr - 128)`

### Reference black/white / headroom and footroom

The `ReferenceBlackWhite` tag supplies, per component, a reference black value
and a reference white value. These define the headroom/footroom range of the
image data: the black value corresponds to the black end of the coding range and
the white value to the white end, allowing scaling of the YCbCr codes into the
full data range when converting to RGB.

For YCbCr the default reference values are black = 0 and white = 255 for the
luma component (Y), and black = 0 and white = 128 for the chroma components
(Cb/Cr).

## Subsampling

- The `YCbCrSubsampling` factors describe how the chroma components are
  subsampled relative to the luma component.
- Subsampling factors of **1, 2 and 4** are the ones covered by the generated
  test images.
- The chroma image dimensions are computed by rounding **up** (ceiling) the
  luma dimensions divided by the subsampling factor, so that no chroma sample is
  dropped for images whose dimensions are not evenly divisible.
- For images using subsampling, strip organization (`RowsPerStrip`) must be
  consistent with the luma/chroma grid; a single strip per image (or rows per
  strip expressed in luma rows) is used by the generated test images.

## Positioning

- `YCbCrPositioning = 1` (default): **centered** positioning of the chroma
  samples with respect to the luminance samples.
- `YCbCrPositioning = 2`: **co-sited** positioning (chroma sample points aligned
  with luma sample points, e.g. recommended for 4:2:2 workflows).

## Minimum requirements for YCbCr images

In addition to the general Baseline TIFF requirements, a YCbCr file must have:

- `SamplesPerPixel = 3` (Y, Cb, Cr).
- `BitsPerSample = 8, 8, 8`.
- `Compression = 1` (none), `5` (LZW) or `7` (JPEG; TIFF Technical Note 2).
- `PhotometricInterpretation = 6` (YCbCr).
- `PlanarConfig = 1` (chunky) or `2` (separate).

## Test image matrix

The generated test images under `tests/ycbcr_images/` and the corresponding
ground-truth RGB images under `tests/reference_images/`.

### Subsampling coverage (all centered, default coefficients, default
`ReferenceBlackWhite`, chunky, BitsPerSample 8, base image 64x48)

| Test image | Subsampling (h x v) | Positioning | Coefficients | RefBW | Planar | Bits | Dimensions | Validates |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ycbcr-1x1.tif` | 1x1 | centered (1) | default | default | chunky | 8 | 64x48 | No subsampling; full-resolution YCbCr. |
| `ycbcr-2x1.tif` | 2x1 | centered (1) | default | default | chunky | 8 | 64x48 | Horizontal subsampling factor 2. |
| `ycbcr-1x2.tif` | 1x2 | centered (1) | default | default | chunky | 8 | 64x48 | Vertical subsampling factor 2. |
| `ycbcr-2x2.tif` | 2x2 | centered (1) | default | default | chunky | 8 | 64x48 | Quarter-resolution chroma (2x2 subsampling). |
| `ycbcr-4x1.tif` | 4x1 | centered (1) | default | default | chunky | 8 | 64x48 | Horizontal subsampling factor 4. |
| `ycbcr-1x4.tif` | 1x4 | centered (1) | default | default | chunky | 8 | 64x48 | Vertical subsampling factor 4. |
| `ycbcr-4x2.tif` | 4x2 | centered (1) | default | default | chunky | 8 | 64x48 | Combined subsampling factors 4 and 2. |
| `ycbcr-2x4.tif` | 2x4 | centered (1) | default | default | chunky | 8 | 64x48 | Combined subsampling factors 2 and 4. |
| `ycbcr-4x4.tif` | 4x4 | centered (1) | default | default | chunky | 8 | 64x48 | Maximum subsampling factor 4 on both axes. |

### Variants

| Test image | Subsampling (h x v) | Positioning | Coefficients | RefBW | Planar | Bits | Dimensions | Validates |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ycbcr-cosited.tif` | 2x2 | co-sited (2) | default | default | chunky | 8 | 64x48 | Co-sited positioning with subsampling. |
| `ycbcr-custom-coeffs.tif` | 1x1 | centered (1) | custom | default | chunky | 8 | 64x48 | Non-default YCbCr coefficients (BT.709). |
| `ycbcr-custom-refbw.tif` | 1x1 | centered (1) | default | custom | chunky | 8 | 64x48 | Non-default reference black/white values. |
| `ycbcr-planar-2x2.tif` | 2x2 | centered (1) | default | default | separate | 8 | 64x48 | Separate planar configuration (PlanarConfig=2). |
| `ycbcr-tiled-2x2.tif` | 2x2 | centered (1) | default | default | chunky (tiled) | 8 | 64x48 | Tiled image organization. |
| `ycbcr-16bit-1x1.tif` | 1x1 | centered (1) | default | default | chunky | 16 | 64x48 | 16 bits per sample YCbCr. |

### Odd (non-divisible) dimensions

| Test image | Subsampling (h x v) | Positioning | Coefficients | RefBW | Planar | Bits | Dimensions | Validates |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ycbcr-odd-2x2.tif` | 2x2 | centered (1) | default | default | chunky | 8 | 61x47 | Chroma dimension ceiling with odd dimensions. |
| `ycbcr-odd-4x4.tif` | 4x4 | centered (1) | default | default | chunky | 8 | 63x61 | Subsampling 4 with odd dimensions. |
| `ycbcr-odd-mixed.tif` | 2x1 | centered (1) | default | default | chunky | 8 | 62x47 | Mixed subsampling and odd dimension handling. |

### Reused image

- `ycbcr-dscf0013.tif` was considered for reuse from `tests/libtiff-pics/dscf0013.tif`
  (uncompressed, YCbCr, 2x1 subsampling, no `ReferenceBlackWhite`); the decision
  was to **reference** it from its existing location rather than copy it into
  `tests/ycbcr_images/`.

## Ground-truth reference images

`tests/reference_images/ycbcr-*.ppm` holds the independent RGB ground-truth
files corresponding to the generated YCbCr test images. They are Netpbm ASCII
PPM (P3) images used by the test suite to validate the YCbCr -> RGB conversion.

## Minimum requirements recap

- `BitsPerSample = 8, 8, 8`.
- `PlanarConfig = 1` (chunky) or `2` (separate).
- `Compression = 1` (none), `5` (LZW) or `7` (JPEG).
- `PhotometricInterpretation = 6` (YCbCr).
